title: Legitimate Internship — Official Portal
text: Hi, I'm reaching out from Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) regarding your application on our careers portal. We would like to invite you for a virtual interview for the Software Engineer Intern position. Please check your registered email for the interview link and schedule. The internship is a paid position (₹15,000/month stipend). No fees are required. For any queries, contact us at careers@tcs.com

title: Campus Placement Drive
text: Dear Students, XYZ Technologies will be conducting a campus recruitment drive on September 15th. Eligible branches: CS, IT, ECE. Package: 6 LPA. Registration through college placement portal only. Bring original documents. Contact your placement coordinator for registration.

title: LinkedIn Job Application Follow-up
text: Thank you for applying for the Product Management Intern role at Swiggy. We have reviewed your application and would like to proceed with a telephonic screening. A recruiter from our team (talent@swiggy.in) will call you on your registered number. This is a paid internship (₹20,000/month). No registration fees are involved.

title: Government Job Notification
text: UPSC Civil Services Examination 2024 — Official Notification. Applications are invited from eligible Indian citizens. Application fee: ₹100 (General), Nil (SC/ST/PwD/Women). Apply only through the official UPSC portal: upsc.gov.in. Beware of fake job portals claiming to offer guaranteed selection.

title: Startup Internship from Internshala
text: Hi! We saw your profile on Internshala. We're a Series A funded startup and are looking for a Marketing intern for 3 months. Stipend: ₹8,000/month. Work from home. No fees. Interview rounds: 1 online assessment + 1 video call. Apply via Internshala or email your CV to hr@ourstartup.com
